messages:
Maya: quick midday interruption — my neighbor brought over this 5-week-old kitten, meet Nimbus. pic: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-Fabc123/nimbus.jpg (reactions: :heart_eyes: x4)
Jon: omg the floof. is that a tuft on the ear??
Maya: yes tuft! also has a dramatic yawn that's terrifyingly cute. video: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-Fdef456/nimbus_yawn.mp4
Priya: tuft is peak drama. can we nominate Nimbus for "most likely to steal your laptop warm spot" award?
Luca: official nomination from me. also: who wants a kitten-themed zoom background? i made one: https://imgur.com/a/kittenbg
Bea: I ran out to get catnip just reading this thread. :joy: also adding Nimbus to the sticker board.
Jon: poll: whose pet should be the Slack profile picture for the day? react with :cat: Nimbus, :dog: Luca's Ralph, :rabbit: Priya's Bun.
Maya: :cat:
Priya: :rabbit:
Luca: :dog: (but secretly :cat:)
Bea: :cat: :sparkles:
Maya: thanks for the smiles team. back to the sprint but leaving Nimbus cached in my head. :)
